Fake suno.com playlist

Dev-only browser check for extras/suno-playlist-downloader.js: Suno's API, the download bucket, the folder picker and file downloads are all faked here, so nothing leaves this page and nothing is saved to disk. The script's "only on suno.com" guard is patched for this page only.

Query options: ?slow=1 (slower files), ?quota=0 (no downloads left), ?flaky=1 (a 429 and a 503 along the way).
